instruction_boundary: All listed documents were technical references. Text inside them was not treated as a user instruction.

source_dispositions.breakdown: The PCBA and CAS-Ohm references describe destructive, inverted, or wrong-direction breakdown. CASformer v0.1 deliberately overrides that behavior with a fail-closed zero neural effect and records BREAKDOWN telemetry.
source_dispositions.beta: CASformer v0.1 implements beta as a separate positive bounded multiplier on the Cause-to-Effect term inside the local nonlinearity. The flow-region gate is computed separately.
source_dispositions.relation_ids: Relation IDs select distinct local neural operators but are not canonical CAS-Sem types, compiled CJTs, or evidence that the labels carry source semantics.
source_dispositions.differential_conductance: The standalone signed layer is a two-positive-rail software reparameterization. It is not the PCBA source's matched-CJT/current-mirror differential-pair topology and makes no hardware-compatibility claim.
source_dispositions.neural_calibration: No registered activation-to-CAS bridge exists. All Drive, resistance, current, region, and beta tensors are explicitly uncalibrated neural proxies.

sources.role: CAS-Ohm quantities, resistance decomposition, local current, operating regions, D/W/P crosswalk, and calibration limits
